boundary: Brain is the ledger: it stores issuer-declared delivery facts and validates their form; it never judges a kind, derives no completion refusal from an attestation and computes no metric. Policy and DORA metrics belong to red-rail, which reads.

issuer.actor_project: a participant of the ticket, from_project or to_project; by agreed convention the executor, to_project, for every kind
issuer.issuer_identity: the normalized X-Brain-Agent caller label; empty, unknown or unexpanded is refused with invalid_issuer
issuer.registry: none; any other label is accepted as declared provenance

kind.reserved_meaning: milestones that are receipts in Brain, read from the ticket, never attestations; still stored if declared, because Brain does not judge kinds

digest.computed_by: server; never supplied by the issuer

emitted_at.compared_as: instants at microsecond precision, never as strings

contract_revision: optional; null means no particular revision; a revision unknown to the ticket is refused with revision_not_found
immutability: append-only by code path: no update and no delete exist

issuance_preconditions.ticket_status: unrestricted; incident_detected and rolled_back may follow closure
issuance_preconditions.feature_enabled: delivery_disabled pauses the mutation, never the read

scopes.ticket: ticket_id given: either ticket participant reads; issuer_project is an optional exact filter
scopes.issuer_project: ticket_id omitted: issuer_project is required (invalid_scope) and must equal actor_project (not_allowed)

list.cursor: opaque keyset bound to the scope that minted it; another scope or a malformed value is refused with invalid_cursor
list.omitted_count: rows matching the same filters beyond the returned page
list.in_delivery_get: view.attestations carries the newest history_limit rows of the ticket
